title: Which NewJeans Member Is Your Perfect Soulmate?
description: Answer 12 questions to discover which NewJeans member is your perfect soulmate!

questions.text: When you have a free afternoon with no plans, you most likely...

options.text: Tackle the small tasks you’ve been putting off, like organizing your desk or trying a new recipe
Doodle in a sketchbook or daydream about planning a future trip to a far-off place
Head to a bustling flea market, striking up conversations with vendors and fellow shoppers
Curl up with a new book or your favorite show, enjoying the quiet of being alone

questions.text: When a friend is upset, you respond by...

options.text: Help them brainstorm practical solutions to fix the problem causing their distress
Listen closely and validate their feelings, sharing similar personal stories to make them feel understood
Suggest a fun distraction like a movie night or walk to take their mind off things
Bring them their favorite snack or a small gift, letting your actions show you care

questions.text: When planning a trip, you focus on...

options.text: Keeping plans flexible, leaving room to explore unexpected spots that catch your eye
Booking all accommodations and activities weeks in advance, following a detailed itinerary
Imagining all the unique memories and stories you’ll bring back from the adventure
Researching local food spots and hidden landmarks to experience the city like a local

questions.text: When you receive a new project at work/school, you...

options.text: Take time to work through the project alone, mapping out your steps before starting
Jump right in, brainstorming creative approaches and collaborating with others early on
Let the project evolve as you go, adapting your ideas based on new insights
Break the project into small, manageable tasks to complete one at a time

questions.text: When choosing a movie to watch, you prefer...

options.text: A clever mystery or sci-fi film that challenges you to solve puzzles or think critically
A lighthearted comedy or classic that you know will make you laugh reliably
A heartfelt drama that makes you reflect on relationships and emotions
A surreal fantasy or experimental film that takes you to a completely new world

questions.text: When meeting someone new, you notice...

options.text: The details of their outfit or the way they arrange their belongings
The way they talk about their dreams and the ideas that excite them
Their interests and goals, asking questions to learn about their long-term plans
Their body language and subtle facial expressions, picking up on unspoken moods

questions.text: When you have a conflict with someone, you...

options.text: Avoid confrontation initially, hoping the issue resolves itself with time
Focus on facts and logic to find a solution that works for both parties
Bring in a mutual friend to mediate, using their perspective to smooth things over
Express your feelings openly, prioritizing understanding each other over winning

questions.text: When you’re feeling stressed, you unwind by...

options.text: Calling up a friend to vent and go out for dinner
Doing something spontaneous like dancing to loud music or baking random treats
Spending time alone doing a calming activity like gardening or journaling
Following a guided meditation or yoga routine to reset your mind

questions.text: When buying a gift for someone, you...

options.text: Create a custom gift like a photo album or handwritten letter filled with personal memories
Select a high-quality, timeless item that they’ll use for years to come
Pick something they’ve mentioned needing or wanting, based on their practical needs
Choose a gift that aligns with their hobbies or interests to show you pay attention

questions.text: When you’re in a group setting, you...

options.text: Bring up random, quirky topics to spark interesting and unexpected discussions
Sit back and listen, only sharing your thoughts when asked directly
Take charge of organizing the conversation, making sure everyone gets a chance to speak
Stick to topics everyone is familiar with to keep the conversation comfortable

questions.text: When you learn something new, you prefer...

options.text: Learning in a structured class with clear deadlines and progress goals
Hands-on practice, learning by doing rather than reading instructions
Experimenting with different methods at your own pace, no strict rules
Watching tutorials or reading articles to understand the theory behind it first

questions.text: When you think about the future, you feel most excited about...

options.text: Making meaningful connections with people from all different backgrounds
Building a stable life with close friends and family, creating consistent routines
Achieving your career or personal goals through hard work and strategy
Pursuing your wildest dreams, even if they take you to unexpected places

results.title: Your Soulmate: Minji (ISTJ)
results.description: Minji is the grounded, reliable backbone of NewJeans. Like her, you value stability and thoughtfulness, preferring to show care through consistent actions rather than grand gestures. You’re attentive to small details, always ready to support loved ones quietly. As an ISTJ, you and Minji would bond over shared routines and the comfort of knowing you can always count on each other.

results.title: Your Soulmate: Danielle (ISFJ)
results.description: Danielle is the warm, nurturing heart of NewJeans. You both find joy in taking care of others, remembering small preferences and going out of your way to make people feel loved. You thrive in cozy, intimate settings and prioritize keeping your relationships strong. As an ISFJ, you and Danielle would create countless gentle, cherished memories together.

results.title: Your Soulmate: Haerin (INFJ)
results.description: Haerin is the quiet, introspective dreamer of NewJeans. You both have a deep inner world, valuing meaningful conversations and emotional depth over superficial interactions. You’re drawn to art and nature, finding peace in quiet moments of reflection. As an INFJ, you and Haerin would connect instantly over shared passions and silent understanding.

results.title: Your Soulmate: Hanni (INTJ)
results.description: Hanni is the clever, strategic thinker of NewJeans. You both approach life with a sharp, analytical mind, preferring to plan ahead and solve problems with creativity. You value independence and intellectual growth, always eager to learn new things. As an INTJ, you and Hanni would challenge each other to reach new heights, bonding over your shared drive to innovate.

results.title: Your Soulmate: Hyein (ISTP)
results.description: Hyein is the adventurous, hands-on spirit of NewJeans. You both love to learn by doing, jumping into new activities and fixing things as you go. You’re calm under pressure, able to think on your feet when faced with unexpected challenges. As an ISTP, you and Hyein would thrive on spontaneous adventures, from trying new sports to building something together from scratch.

You value authenticity and freedom, preferring to live in the moment rather than stress about the future. As an ISFP, you and Haerin would find joy in quiet, creative afternoons and exploring nature’s hidden gems.
